description.narrative:
The Strategic Plan of Civic Resistance/Qëndresa Qytetare has five strategic objectives:
Strategic Objective 1 - Promotion of Improved Educational Services Strategic Objective 2 - Encouraging the participation of citizens in democratic processes Strategic Objective 3 - Strengthening Institutional Capacity via Good Governance Strategic Objective 4 - Networking and Collaboration Strategic Objective 5 - Partnership for Environmental Sustainability

Samarbetet är ett icke öronmärkt stöd till Civic Resistance/ CR/Qëndresa Qytetare och baseras på partnerns strategiska plan 2024-2027. Genom att stärka ungdomars kapacitet, vilket är ett av huvudmålen i den strategiska planen, avser partnern att fungera som en vakthund för offentliga utgifter till universitet och bli en kritisk röst för ungdomar när det gäller utmaningar inom högre utbildning i Albanien. Initiativ inom ramen för den strategiska planen för CR inkluderar övervakning av nationella strategier och resultat för institutioner på central och lokal nivå, organisation av utbildningsakademier för val, rättvisa och medborgarnas deltagande i beslutsfattande, framställningar, kreativa former av protester och medborgarengagemang, kapacitetsuppbyggnad av unga ledare, etc.

The cooperation is un-earmarked support to Civic Resistance/ CR/Qëndresa Qytetare and is based on the partner’s Strategic Plan 2024-2027. Through strengthening the capacities of young people, which is one of the main goals of the strategic plan, the partner intend to act as a watchdog to public spending to universities and become a critical voice of the youth concerning higher education challenges in Albania. Initiatives under the Strategic Plan of CR include various monitoring of national strategies and performance for institutions at central and local level, organization of education academies on election, justice, and citizens participation in decision making, petitions, creative forms of protest and citizen’s engagement, capacity building of young leaders, etc.

description.narrative:
1) Strengthening Electoral Integrity and Accountability - Large-scale public awareness campaign: Qëndresa Qytetare reached about 500,000 citizens through a multi-format online campaign (podcasts, videos, posters, infographics) addressing vote buying and misuse of public resources. - Achieved 56,000 direct social media engagements, demonstrating strong public interaction and discussion. Amplified through dozens of media appearances and articles, extending the reach of findings and denunciations. - The organization monitored the misuse of public institutions and official channels (schools, hospitals, public administration, social media) during electoral campaigns. - Issued 6 targeted recommendations to the Parliamentary Committee on Electoral Reform and the Central Election Commission (CEC). Recommendations were taken into consideration by the CEC and aligned with OSCE/ODIHR findings, with expected regulatory developments before upcoming local elections. Notably, ODIHR explicitly acknowledged for the first time that misuse of public administration favored one political force and undermined equal competition, reflecting the impact of QQs evidence-based advocacy.
2)Empowering Youth for Electoral Oversight - Entering the 2025 electoral year, Qëndresa Qytetare trained 25 young observers (18 girls, 7 boys), equipping them to document violations, file complaints, and follow institutional procedures.Observers reported 64 violations, with 14 formally submitted to the CEC. These complaints triggered 28 CEC review sessions, including witness hearings. Outcomes included 2 financial sanctions, while 12 cases were dismissed due to legal gaps. The lack of sanctions was directly fed into policy recommendations, explicitly targeting legal loopholes in the electoral framework, strengthening QQs role as both watchdog and reform advocate.
3) Creative Civic Engagement and Environmental Advocacy
- QQ organized the Creative Activism Academy in Durrës, engaging 25 youth participants (18 girls, 7 boys) from Durrës and Tirana. Combined creative methods, civic education, and environmental awareness. Strengthened participants understanding of democratic pressure, environmental protection, and public engagement. Following the academy the youth led civic initiatives with public visibility such as: a) The Concrete Garden (Golem): A symbolic public performance denouncing coastal overdevelopment and advocating for green spaces and sustainable development. b) Party with your heart, Not with noise (Skanderbeg Square): A creative action raising awareness of noise pollution from fireworks, promoting safer and environmentally friendly celebrations.
These initiatives demonstrated young peoples ability to translate learning into community-level action with strong public resonance.
4) Influence on Public Debate and Media Discourse Qëndresa Qytetare strengthened its role as a trusted watchdog and policy reference point. Policy analysts contributed to 218 media appearances, using monitoring reports to inform debates on governance, education, transparency, and anti-corruption. This sustained presence increased institutional accountability and broadened public understanding of systemic governance challenges.
Concrete examples of citizen advocacy
- Public student cafeteria in Shkodra: In 2024, QQ and University of Shkodra students launched a petition for a public student cafeteria, collecting 300 signatures submitted to the municipality. The Mayor announced construction in November 2025, and the cafeteria was inaugurated and operational by the 20252026 academic year.
- School safety reform following evidence-based monitoring: QQ identified major gaps in school safety implementation (only 16% of pre-university schools had safety officers; 2,662 cases of violence and bullying reported). The Ministry of Education announced deployment of ~400 trained school safety officers for the 20252026 school year, directly responding to the findings.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
